text: Not sure your marketing is working?
Clicks and lead counts don't pay the bills. Booked estimates do.
Tag every lead with its source: Google, Facebook, referrals, or lead sites.
Then follow each one to a booked estimate, and to a closed job.
Now you can see the cost per booked estimate, for every source.
Spend more where it books. Cut what doesn't.
Want clear numbers? Get a tracking review from Elevate Home Ads.
